$about: Questions for Tim: what a check cannot answer (a look on a real device, a choice). The review page's first page («What needs you») lists the open ones with answer buttons; a button copies the answer («QQ answer · <id>: <answer>») to paste into a chat with Claude, who records it with `npx site-kit checks answer <id> "<answer>" ["note"]`.

about: the files the question is about. An answer is stored with those files' fingerprints (git blob hashes): when one of them changes, the question opens again («changed since your answer»), so an OK given to an older build never covers a newer one.
needs: iphone | mac-safari | eye (look at it anywhere) | choice. link: where to look (the test site unless a PR preview is named).
status: open | answered. A question can also be closed by a decision (answer.decision) or dropped (status: dropped, with why).

questions.ask: QQ grinds only for turka, filter and espresso. 13 of 106 respondents of the B2C survey brew in a moka pot and 7 in a French press, and every Russian roaster that names its grinds by method has one for the moka pot. For now the catalogue sets «в зёрнах» for both (the espresso roast for the moka pot, any roast for the French press) and says QQ has no such grind. Should QQ add a moka-pot grind and a coarse grind for the French press, or advise its espresso grind for the moka pot?
questions.from: session 3 of choosing coffee (data/choose.json asks; docs/choose-check/survey.md)
options: Advise the espresso grind for the moka pot

questions.ask: The navbar links only to pages that exist (an item without a page is a label: decision nav-links-pages). The hero's and the footer's links are not under that rule yet. Should they follow it too (no link where there is no page), or stay as they are?

On your iPhone, in Safari: scroll any page down and up with the tab bar at the bottom. Does Safari's own bottom bar stay plain glass, or does it take the tab bar's colour (or turn white)? Safari tints its bar from anything fixed at the bottom edge (a lesson of Flow Medium, site-kit AGENTS.md). PR #18 adds Flow Medium's guard (an empty fixed block over that point, site-kit/runtime/safari.css): look at the test site once PR #18 has merged (before that, PR #18's preview: https://timofeylebedev.github.io/qq/pr-preview/pr-18/catalog/), the catalog and a coffee's page (its buy bar sits on the tab bar), also near the footer.
options: It takes a colour (say which page)

questions.ask: The site has no page of its own for a wrong address: GitHub Pages shows its plain «404 File not found». Make a QQ page for it (the navbar, a line and a link to the catalog), or leave it until the real host?
options: Leave it until the real host

questions.ask: On your Mac, in Safari (26 or later): the page now scrolls in its own box, as on Flow Medium, so Safari's top bar should stay solid instead of glass over the page. Open the home page, the catalog and a coffee's page, in light and dark mode: is the bar solid? Then scroll each one through: does the navbar change colour with the sections, does the coffee's pack stay pinned and turn with the scroll, do the space bar, the arrows and Page Down scroll the page, does a reload keep the place, does a card open its coffee with the transition (and back)? With ?qqbox=0 at the end of the address the box is off, to compare (the link has ?qqbox=1, which only forces the box; in Safari 26+ it is on by itself, and links to the next page do not carry the parameter). The link is the test site: it shows this once PR #18 has merged (before that, PR #18's preview: https://timofeylebedev.github.io/qq/pr-preview/pr-18/).
options: Something is off (say what and where)
